about.title: About MirhalGo
about.body: MirhalGo is a smart shipping marketplace built in Egypt. Instead of calling company after company, you submit one shipping request and receive competitive price quotes from verified shipping and customs-clearance companies. Our team reviews every request and every offer, protects your data, and stays with you until your shipment is delivered.
about.imageAlt: Shipping containers stacked at a port
